title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode15 Precious to Me

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I detect a note of uncertainty in your guitar playing and singing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Luka, do you mind if I ask you for advice on something personal?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have a friend who's really important to me, and I want to respect her choices, but by doing that, I also feel like I'm failing her...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have no idea what to do.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to do what's right for everyone...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You know, there's no right or wrong in music.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Everyone brings their own tune to the table. Think of how you and your friends could put your tunes together into a beautiful melody.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A melody for all of us...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hi. Are you okay, Saki? You look kinda pale, and you've got bags under your eyes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaat, really? Haha, no need to worry. I stayed up late thinking about stuff, that's why.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was just wondering whether we should tell Hona that we won't bother her about joining anymore.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Seems unnecessary.
We just won't ask her again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, but with how she is, I think she'll be agonizing over it unless we tell her we've given up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, it's best that we let her know our decision!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona! Sorry to interrupt your lunch break, but do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but... I was going to have lunch with some friends...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I won't take much of your time! And I won't ever bother you again, I promise!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sorry for being so insistent, asking you to join our band again and again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really wanted to find something that would bring the four of us together again, you know.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I didn't realize how selfish I was being.
I didn't consider it from your point of view.
I'm really sorry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi told me everything. About what you went through in junior high school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If something like that happened to me, I don't know how I'd have coped. It must have been so awful for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I don't want to get between you and the friends you have now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, that's all I wanted to say. Thanks for listening, and sorry for earlier.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Do you think she's okay?
We should've gone with her....

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, guys! Sorry to keep you waiting!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How did it go? Did you tell her?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! I told her everything...
Oh... Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't know why I'm crying... Haha... The tears just won't stop for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you sure you're okay with giving up on Honami?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I want what's best for her. And this is it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We won't be hanging out together, but at least I can always walk by her classroom and look in to see how she's doing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, shoot. The lunch break is almost over and we haven't eaten lunch yet!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki hasn't been herself ever since she spoke to Honami.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Do you think it really was for the best?
